model_annotation: Figure 4 presents a bar chart illustrating the number of participants in a study evaluating a web-based tool designed for fact-checking. The horizontal axis, labeled “Participant Tool,” displays the names of six different participant tools: “FC Summary,” “Veracity Explanation,” “Number of Participants,” “Simplicity,” “Clarity,” and “Overall Summary.” The vertical axis, titled “Number of Participants (N = 6),” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The tallest bar, representing “Number of Participants,” reaches a height of 6, while the shortest bar, “Simplicity,” reaches a height of 1. All other bars fall between 2 and 5.  The bars are presented in ascending order based on their height, and no bars are visually emphasized.
